tokens.name: on-color
tokens.usage: Text on meaning fills and player avatars stays white in both themes.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind every floating surface. From the game's Interstate tokens.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces: family cards, panes, state cards. No border; a border means selected.

tokens.name: elevated
tokens.usage: Hover cards, menus and dialogs that sit above a card.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Inputs, inactive chips, the track behind pill tabs, image wells.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers inside a surface and the empty part of progress bars. Never an outline around a surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and icon strokes on ground, card and fill. 16.7:1 on card (light), 12.9:1 (dark).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: counts, captions, helper lines. 7.7:1 on card (light), 6.9:1 (dark).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Plate ids and metadata. 5.6:1 on card, 4.9:1 on ground (light); 6.1:1 (dark).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Every filled action and selection: primary buttons, the active tab and chip, selected borders, checkboxes, the run banner, toasts. The game's dark-mode elevated green; inverts to off-white in dark mode, as the game's ink does.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary. 15.1:1 (light).

tokens.name: tag-ink
tokens.usage: Tag text and icons on fill; meets WCAG AA in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Means good, never 'clickable': passed checks, progress, switches that are on, live-editing rings. The game's State Spotter green. 6.5:1 on card (light); 3.2:1 in dark, so icons and fills only there, not small text.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Background for added values in a before/after and for 'Likely a plate'. Dark value derived for this system.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Weak checks and warning icons only. 4.3:1 on card: icons and 24px+ text, never small text (use warning-ink).

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text on warning-tint: conflict banners, 'review' badges, Publish warnings.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background for conflicts, weak values and Publish warnings.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Missing checks, Decline, Stop run, the final Push button. The game's Time Attack red. 5.4:1 on card (light). Dark value is 3.5:1 on card: icons and filled buttons with white text only, not small text on card.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background for removed values in a before/after and for empty-but-required sections. Dark value derived for this system.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Publish, links and 'changed' chips: things headed to players. The game's State Run blue. 7.8:1 on card (light); 3.0:1 in dark, so dark-mode links use ink with an underline.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Background for 'changed' chips and submitted-batch badges.

tokens.name: player-you
tokens.usage: Your avatar.

tokens.name: player-friend
tokens.usage: The next collaborator's avatar; further people take player-third and player-fourth.

tokens.name: player-third
tokens.usage: Third collaborator's avatar.

tokens.name: player-fourth
tokens.usage: Fourth collaborator's avatar.

tokens.name: rarity-1
tokens.usage: Local (tier 1). Same in both themes, as in the game.

tokens.name: rarity-2
tokens.usage: Regular (tier 2).

tokens.name: rarity-3
tokens.usage: Out-of-Towner (tier 3).

tokens.name: rarity-4
tokens.usage: Long Hauler (tier 4).

tokens.name: rarity-5
tokens.usage: Rare Bird (tier 5).

tokens.name: rarity-6
tokens.usage: Holy Grail (tier 6).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per page: the jurisdiction or page name.

styles.name: dialog-title
styles.usage: Dialog and warning titles, as in the game.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section headings, sentence case, never tracked caps (the game's SectionHeading).

styles.name: plate-name
styles.usage: Template names on cards. Wraps to two lines; never truncated.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Proceeds support the state's veterans programs.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, chip and tab text.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Results land in your Review batch.
styles.usage: Helper lines and hover-card detail. ink-2 or darker only.

styles.name: id
styles.usage: Plate ids, family keys, revisions. Never for prose.

styles.name: count
styles.usage: Counts, versions and timings so digits line up.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its count; avatar overlap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a thumbnail and its text; row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; pane padding; minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on the Plate page.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap before a page's footer content.

tokens.name: stack-gap
tokens.usage: The one gap between stacked page components (review strip, search, state header, batch actions, filter row, card grid) and between cards. Never mix other values between siblings on a page.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Plate thumbnails and keyboard hints.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, list rows, image wells.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces: cards, panes, menus.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, as in the game.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button, tab, chip, badge and avatar.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Only for things that float above other surfaces: hover cards, menus, the run menu. Cards and panes have no shadow.

tokens.name: icon-chrome
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons, tabs and menus. 1.5 stroke on a 16 grid, beside small UI.

tokens.name: icon-status
tokens.usage: The seven plate checks on cards. Same glyphs, scaled; stroke scales with it.

tokens.name: icon-stroke
tokens.usage: Stroke width at 16px; hard caps and consistent angles.
